weapons.name: Flare Gun
weapons.desc: Fires a flare at the nearest enemy.

weapons.name: Lantern Orb
weapons.desc: Orbs of light circle you and knock enemies back.

weapons.name: Harpoon Chain
weapons.desc: Throws a harpoon forward. Pierces enemies.

weapons.name: Tide Bell
weapons.desc: Sends out a wave that knocks enemies back.

weapons.name: Signal Mirror
weapons.desc: Flashes a beam at the nearest enemy. Hits everything in the line.

weapons.name: Oil Flask
weapons.desc: Lobs a flask at the nearest enemy. It bursts into burning oil.

weapons.name: Lightning Rod
weapons.desc: Lightning strikes random enemies on screen and jumps to 2 more.

weapons.name: Corpse Candles
weapons.desc: Summons candle flames that drift after enemies. Their touch rots: rotting enemies take 25% more damage.

weapons.name: Flare Barrage
weapons.desc: Fires 3 flares at once. Flares explode on hit.

weapons.name: Lighthouse Lens
weapons.desc: 5 orbs circle you without stopping. Sets enemies on fire.

weapons.name: Kraken Line
weapons.desc: Harpoons chain between enemies and pull them in.

weapons.name: Storm Bell
weapons.desc: Sends out 2 waves that freeze enemies.

weapons.name: Lamplight
weapons.desc: Burns nearby enemies. Grows with each level.

options.name: Salvo
options.desc: Every 4th shot also sets off a ring of 8 flares.

options.name: Mortar
options.desc: Flares are lobbed onto the thickest crowd and burst where they land. +30% Cooldown.

options.name: Hanging Flare
options.desc: Where a flare hits, it hangs for 4s and rains sparks.

options.name: Eclipse
options.desc: The orbs merge into one big orb that grows with each kill and bursts when full.

options.name: Hunting Lights
options.desc: Orbs break away to chase enemies.

options.name: Wards
options.desc: Where an orb kills, a small lantern stays and pulses for 5s.

options.name: Lunge
options.desc: Each dash throws a harpoon in 4 directions.

options.name: Skewer
options.desc: The first enemy a harpoon hits is carried along as a ram, and bursts at the end.

options.name: Tether
options.desc: The harpoon sticks in the last enemy it hits. The chain back to you hurts whatever crosses it.

options.name: Great Toll
options.desc: One huge ring every 6s instead of waves. Each kill brings the next one sooner, by up to half the wait.

options.name: Breakers
options.desc: Waves start at the edge of the screen and roll inward, dragging enemies with them.

options.name: Riptide
options.desc: Enemies a wave hits are thrown, and hurt whatever they land among.

options.name: Full Circle
options.desc: The beam sweeps a full circle around you.

options.name: Relay
options.desc: The beam jumps on to 3 more enemies, 25% stronger each jump.

options.name: Burning Glass
options.desc: The beam sets enemies on fire. Each time it finds one again within 2.5s, the fire burns 25% hotter, up to 3x.

options.name: Slick Trail
options.desc: Leaves a trail of burning oil while moving.

options.name: Firebomb
options.desc: Each flask bursts into 4 small ones.

options.name: Fuel Line
options.desc: Pools that touch link up. A new pool sets off every pool linked to it.

options.name: Planted Rod
options.desc: Plants a rod on the spot. Strikes fall around it, 2 more at a time.

options.name: Storm Front
options.desc: Each strike marches on in a line, away from you.

options.name: Static
options.desc: Struck enemies carry a charge for 3s and zap their neighbors.

options.name: Pyre
options.desc: The flames gather in a pyre, then erupt all at once.

options.name: Will-o'-Wisps
options.desc: The flames lure nearby enemies toward them, away from you.

options.name: Vigil
options.desc: Each kill leaves a new flame where the enemy fell.

passives.name: Ballast
passives.desc: +1 Pierce and +12% Knockback (Steel). Gains Damage as it levels.

passives.name: Undertow
passives.desc: +1 Projectile (Tide). Gains Damage and Duration as it levels.

passives.name: Thick Coat
passives.desc: +15 Max HP per level. +1 Armor at Lv 3 and Lv 5.

passives.name: Lucky Knot
passives.desc: +12% Luck per level. Better relics, chests, and drops.

runes.name: Orbiting
runes.desc: Shots orbit you instead of flying off.

relics.name: Spark Flint
relics.desc: Starting a dash sets off a burst of sparks where you stood.

relics.name: Tide Clock
relics.desc: Every 45s, a wave knocks back nearby enemies.

relics.name: Reaper's Wake
relics.desc: Kills made while dashing drop double XP.

relics.name: Glass Lantern
relics.desc: Healing becomes a shield instead, up to 50% of Max HP.

relics.name: Barnacle Shell
relics.desc: Taking a hit sends out a wave that throws enemies back. Once every 6s.

relics.name: Seventh Bell
relics.desc: Every 7th level-up evolves each weapon that can evolve. No chest needed.

relics.name: Wreck Lantern
relics.desc: Every 5th kill leaves burning oil on the ground.

relics.name: Drowned Bell
relics.desc: Every 30 kills, the bell tolls and hits everything near you for 40 damage.

characters.name: Lamplighter
characters.desc: Carries a lamp that burns nearby enemies. The lamp grows as she levels up.

characters.name: Harpooner
characters.desc: Pulls enemies in and dazes them for 0.4s. Gains Armor for each enemy close by.
characters.hubLine: Tide's turning. Say the word and I'll head out.

enemies.name: Gull
enemies.desc: A gull the fog got to.

enemies.name: Mud Crab
enemies.desc: Winds up, then runs at you.

enemies.name: Bloater
enemies.desc: Bursts into rats when it dies.

enemies.name: Bilge Rat
enemies.desc: Fast and weak. Comes in packs.

enemies.name: Lantern Eater
enemies.desc: Spits pools of black water. Watch the rings.

enemies.name: Wreck Gunner
enemies.desc: Lobs slow cannonballs. Easy to see coming.

enemies.name: The Tidecaller
enemies.desc: Rings a bell that brings the tide in.

maps.name: Drowned Docks
maps.desc: The flooded harbor front. 20 minutes, 2 bosses.

secrets.name: Wreck Cache
secrets.hint: Something glints aboard the wreck in the far northeast.

materials.name: Coin
materials.desc: Tarnished coins from the tide line.

materials.name: Oil
materials.desc: Lamp oil. Lamp Post burns it.

materials.name: Drowned Pages
materials.desc: Ledger pages the sea gave back.

materials.name: Marsh Herbs
materials.desc: Bitter leaves from the Salt Marsh.

materials.name: Salt Glass
materials.desc: Glass fused by lightning on the salt flats.

materials.name: Bone
materials.desc: From the Sunken Chapel. Best not to ask.

buildings.name: Lamp Post
buildings.desc: Burns Oil to push the fog back. Unlocks permanent upgrades.

buildings.name: Library
buildings.desc: Researches new weapons, passives, and runes.

buildings.name: Tavern
buildings.desc: Brings new characters and relics to the harbor.

buildings.name: Docks
buildings.desc: Mends the boats. Ferryman sails into runs from here.

buildings.name: Smithy
buildings.desc: Makes and improves gear, and cuts rune stones.

buildings.name: Chapel
buildings.desc: Opens the higher Tides and the curses. Rings the Fog Bells louder.

buildings.name: Market
buildings.desc: Trades one material for another, at a poor rate. Buys back your Sea Glass.

buildings.name: Apothecary
buildings.desc: Sells what you take into a run: tonics, salts, and charms.

buildings.name: Cartographer
buildings.desc: Charts the maps: where the tasks are, what the bestiary is worth, challenge runs, and short runs.

research.name: Orbwright's Notes
research.desc: Notes on holding light in glass.

research.name: Tide Charts
research.desc: The old harbormaster's tide charts.

research.name: Rune Stones
research.desc: Carved stones from the breakwater.

research.name: Signal Codes
research.desc: The flashes ships used to talk across the water.

research.name: Oil Stores
research.desc: A chandler's ledger of what burns and how well.

research.name: Ship's Ballast
research.desc: Notes on keeping a ship upright.

research.name: Sailor's Almanac
research.desc: A sailor's book of weather and luck.

research.name: Reversed Runes
research.desc: Runes cut in reverse.

research.name: Storm Glass
research.desc: A sealed glass that clouds before lightning.

research.name: Volatile Salts
research.desc: Salts that burst when handled.

research.name: Corpse Lights
research.desc: Accounts of candle flames seen over drowned men.

research.name: Smith's Ledger
research.desc: Patterns for hoods, coats, gloves, and boots.

research.name: Herbalist's Notes
research.desc: What the old apothecary mixed, and for what.

research.name: Drowned Charms
research.desc: Small things sailors carried for luck.

research.name: Compass Rose
research.desc: Instrument makers' drawings: compasses and rings.

research.name: Moon Tables
research.desc: When the water rises, and how far.

research.name: Deep Salvage
research.desc: A diver's log of what the wrecks still hold.

research.name: Brine Rites
research.desc: Old words said over the water.

research.name: Tide Forging
research.desc: Working iron with the tide in it.

research.name: Lantern Lore
research.desc: Why the drowned bell still rings.

npcs.name: Old Wick
npcs.desc: Lamplighter for 40 years, until the fog came.

lines.text: Forty years I lit these streets. Nice to have help.
Silas says you read everything twice. Good habit.
The fog backs off from a steady flame. Keep it fed.
Half these pages are soup. The other half are worth it.
Bring me more drowned pages. The sea keeps the good stories.
Sit anywhere. Most of the chairs have legs now.
Sailors come back when the lamps do. Funny, that.
The Ferryman pays in favors. I take them.
Every hull here floats. Most of them on purpose.
Bring iron. I can make most things out of most things.
Six slots. Wear them all or the work was for nothing.
The tide comes higher every time you ask it to.
Ten tides. Nobody asked for an eleventh yet.
A bad trade beats no trade. Usually.
Sea Glass. Pretty, worthless, and I buy it anyway.
Drink it before you go out. Not after.
Three bottles a run. More and you rattle.
The docks are bigger than they look. Smaller than they feel.
I marked the wreck. Don't say I gave it away.

consumables.name: Glass Pouch
consumables.desc: Start the run with 20 Sea Glass.

arcana.name: High Water
arcana.desc: Every 60s, every gem on the map flies to you.

arcana.name: Brine
arcana.desc: Kills by Tide weapons heal you 1 HP, up to 3 a second.

arcana.name: Kindling
arcana.desc: Elites drop an Ember twice as often, and bosses drop 2.

arcana.name: Glassblower
arcana.desc: Relics are offered a tier better. -15% Max HP.

challenges.name: Lamp Only
challenges.desc: Lamplighter, with no new weapons from level-ups. Survive 10:00.

challenges.name: Bare Hands
challenges.desc: Harpooner, with no passives. Kill The Harbor Maw.

challenges.name: Flood
challenges.desc: Lamplighter at Tide 4 with Swarm. Survive 8:00.

feats.name: Lantern Night
feats.desc: Light every Wayside Lamp in one run.

feats.name: Bell Ringer
feats.desc: Ring 3 Fog Bells in one run.

feats.name: Three Forms
feats.desc: Give a weapon all 3 of its Forms.

feats.name: High Tide
feats.desc: Clear the Drowned Docks at Tide 5.

kits.name: Orb Kit
kits.desc: Start with the Lantern Orb instead of the Flare Gun.

kits.name: Bell Kit
kits.desc: Start with the Tide Bell instead of the Harpoon.
